# firezone_oidc_auth_provider (Data Source)

Firezone OIDC Auth Provider data source



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Provider ID

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 Client ID
- `context` (String) Provider context
- `discovery_document_uri` (String) OIDC Discovery Document URI
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default provider
- `is_disabled` (Boolean) Whether the provider is disabled
- `name` (String) Provider name
- `scope` (String) OAuth2 scope
